name: The Startup (Volatile Market)
description: The volatile variant of The Startup, on the same engine, rules and scoring. The hidden market is the same as the standard variant's for each seed, but events hit harder: demand is noisier month to month (±15%), the supplier surcharge is deeper (+50–80%) and lasts four months (still announced a month ahead), the competitor's price war cuts prices by 30%, and a one-month safety scare cuts category demand by about 40%. Scores are still normalised between the autopilot and an oracle that knows everything, so the test rewards founders who read the market from their own results and hedge ahead of shocks.
hook: Same $10,000, a far more volatile market: a deeper supplier spike, a brutal price war and a demand crash.
author: Gauntlet Core
